column1: View less classifications","INSTITUTE OF GENETICS AND DEVELOPMENTAL BIOLOGY, CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES中国科学院遗传与发育生物学研究所",YU HONG余泓SONG XIAOGUANG宋晓光LI JIAYANG李家洋MENG XIANGBING孟祥兵,北京纪凯知识产权代理有限公司 11245,,(EN) Breeding method for carrying out saturated base editing on specific gene of plant(ZH) 一种对植物特定基因进行饱和碱基编辑的育种方法,,"(EN) The invention discloses a plant breeding method for carrying out saturated base editing on a specific gene. The plant breeding method comprises the following steps: 1) selecting a gene to be edited; 2) designing targets of a protein coding region and a gene expression regulation region of a targeting to-be-edited gene; 3) preparing a construct by using a single-base editing CRISPR system according to the designed targets; (4) preparing a transgenic crop as a first-generation plant by utilizing the construct in the step (3); and (5) screening the first generation of plants in the step (4) or plants with homozygous edited genomes in the later generations of the plants as parents for breeding. The invention relates to a method for carrying out base editing on all or multiple target sequences in selected genes in plant (such as crop plants) genomes through a Cas single base editing fusion protein guided by guide RNA (Ribonucleic Acid) to obtain different phenotypes of progenies, and plant progenies and alleles obtained with the method.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种对特定基因进行饱和碱基编辑的植物育种方法，包括如下步骤：1)选定一个待编辑基因；2)设计靶向待编辑基因的蛋白编码区及基因表达调控区的靶点，3)根据设计的靶点利用单碱基编辑CRISPR系统制备构建体；4)利用步骤3)中的构建体制备转基因作物，作为一代植株；5)筛选步骤4)中的一代植株或其后代中基因组纯合编辑的植株作为亲本育种。本发明通过向导RNA指导的Cas单碱基编辑融合蛋白对植物(例如作物植物)基因组中选定基因中所有或多个靶序列进行碱基编辑以获得不同表型后代的方法及通过此方法获得的植物后代及等位基因。",,,,,,,,

According to the method, gene editing can be realized more quickly, time and labor cost are saved, more accurate gene editing can be realized, unintentional mutation or non-specific editing is avoided, so that the editing accuracy and repeatability are improved, the influence of pathogenic bacteria on crops is reduced by improving the disease resistance of plants, and the crop quality is improved. Therefore, the yield and quality of crops are improved.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种提高植物基因编辑效率的方法，包括，选择目标基因，使用CRISPR设计工具设计单指导RNA序列；根据单指导RNA序列构建CRISPR‑Cas9表达载体；利用植物转化方法进行植物转化和筛选；根据筛选结果进行分子分析和验证；根据编辑结果进行功能验证和优化改进。本发明能够更快速地实现基因编辑，节省时间和劳动力成本，够实现更精确的基因编辑，避免无意的突变或非特异性编辑，从而提高编辑的准确性和可重复性，并且通过提高植物的抗病性，有助于降低病原菌对农作物的影响，从而提高农作物的产量和品质。",,,,,,,,

孙永伟 SUN, Yongwei",北京纪凯知识产权代理有限公司 JEEKAI&PARTNERS,"data:image/png;base64,",(EN) APPLICATION OF CRISPR/NCAS9 MEDIATED SITE-DIRECTED BASE SUBSTITUTION IN PLANTS(FR) APPLICATION DE SUBSTITUTION DE BASE SITE DIRIGÉE MÉDIÉE PAR CRISPR/NCAS9 DANS DES PLANTES(ZH) 一种CRISPR/nCas9介导的定点碱基替换在植物中的应用,,"(EN) A CRISPR/nCas9 mediated site-directed base substitution applied to plants. The site-directed base substitution is achieved by a system of site-directed editing plant genomes, and the system comprises a BE3 plant expression vector expressing a fusion protein composed of nCas9 (D10A), deaminase, and a uracil DNA glycosylase inhibitory protein, and the system was verified by using rice OsPDS and OsSBEIIb as target genes. The results showed that among three selected target sites, expected site-directed mutant plants were all obtained, accurate site mutation of the base in rice was achieved, and the highest efficiency reached about 20%, thus providing a feasible and effective method of base substitution for crop breeding. The method has strong potential for application in agricultural breeding and provides a basis for rapidly improving important agronomic traits of crops.(FR) L'invention concerne une substitution de base site dirigée médiée par CRISPR/nCas9 appliquée à des plantes. La substitution de base site dirigée est obtenue par un système d'édition site dirigée de génomes de plantes, et le système comprend un vecteur d'expression de plante BE3 exprimant une protéine de fusion composée de nCas9 (D10A), de la désaminase, et d'une protéine inhibitrice de l'uracile-ADN glycosylase, et le système a été vérifié en utilisant les OsPDS et OsSBEIIb du riz en tant que gènes cibles. Les résultats ont montré que, parmi trois sites cibles sélectionnés, les plantes mutantes site dirigées attendues étaient toutes obtenues, une mutation de site précise de la base dans le riz a été obtenue, et l'efficacité la plus élevée a atteint environ 20 %, offrant ainsi un procédé réalisable et efficace de substitution de base pour l'amélioration génétique des cultures Le procédé a un fort potentiel pour une application dans l'amélioration génétique agricole et fournit une base pour l'amélioration rapide des traits agronomiques importants de cultures.(ZH) 一种CRISPR/nCas9介导的定点碱基替换在植物中的应用。所述定点碱基替换通过定点编辑植物基因组的系统实现，该系统包括BE3植物表达载体，BE3植物表达载体表达由nCas9(D10A)、脱氨酶和尿嘧啶DNA糖基化酶抑制蛋白组成的融合蛋白，并以水稻OsPDS和OsSBEIIb为靶基因对该系统进行验证。结果表明，在所选的3个靶点中，均获得预期定点突变植株，在水稻中实现了碱基的精确的点突变，且效率最高达到20％左右，为农作物育种提供了一种可行的有效的碱基替换方法，在农业育种方面具有强大的应用潜力，为快速改良农作物重要农艺性状提供了基础。",201611091107.701.12.2016CN,,PCT/CN2017/110349,10.11.2017,Chinese (zh),Chinese (zh),"View all

The nucleotide sequence of an open reading frame of the OsFd4 gene is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, and the amino acid sequence coded by the OsFd4 gene is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 2. The rice gene OsFd4 is knocked out by adopting a CRISPR/Cas9 method, and bacterial blight pathogenic bacterium inoculation experiments are respectively carried out on a wild type plant and a mutant knockout plant. Results show that the OsFd4 is knocked out, so that the active oxygen outbreak and callose deposition level of rice plants after treatment of bacterial pathogenic bacteria flagellin oligopeptide is obviously improved, and the resistance of rice to bacterial blight bacteria is further enhanced. According to the detection platform, the pathogenic bacteria of the pine canker can be subjected to dual-specificity detection through recombinase polymerase amplification and crRNA recognition, the specificity and the visualization are high, the sensitivity can be as low as 1 pg.mu L <-1>, and the pathogenic bacteria of the pine canker carried on imported plants of a port can be detected and prevented immediately.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种基于CRISPR‑Cas12a体系可视化检测松树脂溃疡病病原菌(Fusarium circinatum)的检测方法，该方法通过重组酶聚合酶扩增后的目的DNA片段，再在crRNA序列介导下，引导CRISPR‑Cas12a体系对扩增产物进行识别结合并切割目标双链DNA激活非特异性核酸酶功能，然后任意切割体系中的单链DNA荧光探针得到裂解产物，最后通过裂解产物的显色检测进行判断。该检测平台通过重组酶聚合酶扩增及crRNA识别可双重特异地对松树脂溃疡病病原菌进行检测，特异性强，可视化强，且在灵敏度上可低至1 pg·μL‑1，对于港口的进境植物上携带的松树脂溃疡病病原菌实现即检即防。",,,China,29.04.2022,A,,

The protein for regulating and controlling the corn bracts, which is disclosed by the invention, is a PCD2C protein of which the amino acid sequence is a sequence 3. According to the invention, a deletion mutant (crispr-pcd2c) of a corn PCD2C gene is obtained by adopting a CRISPR-Cas9 gene knockout method, and 244 nucleotides are deleted from the PCD2C gene in the mutant to cause the protein coding missense mutation. Biosensors for small molecules can be used in applications that range from metabolic engineering to orthogonal control of transcription.
